sourceCrsPossibilities: EPSG:4326 for latitude/longitude shelter or OSM source coordinates
local projected CRS for metric official GIS layers
PLATEAU/CityGML coordinate conventions that must be verified before processing
crsStrategy.candidateProcessingCrs: A reviewed projected CRS suitable for Tokyo/Chuo, such as Japan Plane Rectangular CS zone IX, should be selected in P5-B3.

operationsRequiringProjectedCrs: contains or boundary-sensitive spatial matching after CRS normalization
metricOperationRules.ruleNote: Never compute meter distances directly in unprojected latitude/longitude.

unityCoordinatePolicy.policyNote: GIS CRS to Unity Vector3 mapping is separate from P5-B spatial processing.

manualChecks: no visible coordinate shift between layers
routes are not flying, disconnected, or crossing impossible gaps in obvious ways
shelter point near or inside matched building
low-confidence and unmatched points are inspectable
hazard context layers align with basemap/reference layers
source CRS and processed CRS are visible in layer metadata
outputFormats: small GeoJSON QA layers when explicitly approved
risks: Axis-order mistakes can swap latitude and longitude.
Geographic CRS distances can silently produce wrong meter thresholds.
PLATEAU-derived building footprints may not share the same CRS as source points.
QGIS visual alignment can hide source-provenance or attribute errors.
Unity coordinate conversion can introduce a second alignment problem if attempted before processed GIS outputs are stable.
